nodes.label: Never Assert getByRole('alert') in e2e
nodes.rationale: The Next.js App Router renders a visually-hidden role='alert' route announcer on every navigation, so asserting on getByRole('alert') matches or races the announcer, producing flaky, misleading results — target the specific rendered text or element instead.

nodes.label: Passcode-Only Auth in e2e
nodes.rationale: Google sign-in requires a real IdP and is out of scope for e2e; tests use the shared-passcode path with HOUSEHOLD_PASSCODE=e2e-pass from playwright.config.ts's webServer.env.
